title: Elizondo on aliens storing messages in genetics

tellings.quote: he said something really interesting if you were going to make something truly enduring truly enduring there's really only two ways to do it you either put something out and deep space where the chances are of it coming into contact with something or minimal or biology genetics

plain: Michels says a former Pentagon official named Luis Elizondo once told him that if you wanted to make something that truly lasts, there are only two ways to do it: send it out into deep space, where it is unlikely to run into anything, or write it into biology and genetics. Michels passes this on as Elizondo's idea of how an intelligence from elsewhere might leave a message, which would mean that something could be written into living things, ourselves included.
